project.name: Balchrystie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 5 of 8. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. Balchrystie House and farms are private. Largo, Elie and surrounding services are not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Balchrystie is a dispersed historic house and farm locality. Its extensive records remain in the heritage layer, but private fabric does not constitute a public attraction and no visitor facilities were verified.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No destination-scale dog visit or dedicated dog facilities are assumed without current evidence.
